name: Silicon photonics
source: Goldman Sachs optical note (04-17-2026) + GlobalFoundries Q1 FY2026 (05-05-2026) + Tower Semiconductor Q2 FY2026 (08-04-2026) + Onto Innovation Q2 FY2026 (08-06-2026)
note: 1.6T SiPh module saves ~$144/module on lasers (4x70mW CW vs 8x200G EML). TSMC manufactures the silicon-photonics PICs.

tables.title: Silicon photonics trajectory
rows: designed in at 3 of top-4 pluggable transceiver makers
$1B run rate targeted Q4-2026; ~$1.3B CONTRACTED for 2027 (w/ $290M prepayments); corporate 2028 model raised to $3.6B / 45% GM
$920M program = wafer starts 3x Q2-26 shipments by Q4-26 (full P&L effect Q2-27)
Track 1: Arai 300mm SiPho + adv packaging ready Q4-2027; Track 2: new Uozu fab = 4x Japan 300mm output by Q4-2028 (>=20-25k wpm SiPho); post-2027 all SiPho growth is 300mm
pluggables (800G/1.6T) have already replaced copper for SCALE-OUT outside the rack; several NPO deployments planned over the next year
NPO = 'tens of percent' of SiPho shipments by H2-2027; integrated InP lasers (III-V on SiPho, IQE epi supply) = tens of $M in 2027; coherent (Marvell multi-million modules) carries SCALE-ACROSS
gain chips shipping in volume to 3 anchor customers + new wins; high-power CW laser sampled to 5-6 module makers (1 laser splits into 4 or 8 channels for 1.6T/3.2T)

SOA + CW qual within ~2 months, CW-laser transceiver REVENUE from H1 FY2028; PD arrays added for 3.2T TIA+PD co-optimization; fab capacity 3-4x by end-FY2027; content/transceiver high-single-digit $ -> $80-90 at 3.2T (Semtech Q2 FY2027)
served market >$500M by 2030 (light guides / generation / detection)
